unresolved: Table 2 reports oxide forms (MgO, Al2O3, PbO, HgO, As2O3, etc.); the paper does not state whether values are element or oxide mass, and no conversion was made.
Drying, moisture and basis (dry or fresh) are not stated; ED-XRF pellets imply dried powder but this is not confirmed.
Macro and non-metal elements (Mg, Si, P, S, K, Ca, Ti, Rb, Y, Zr, I, Hf) were printed but not extracted as they are outside heavy-metal scope.
Number of fruiting bodies per species and collection dates are not reported.
Lead value 55.077 mg/kg printed identically for L. deliciosus and H. sinapizans.
